summary: @rickwysocki Kings are all lined up. Go into it with a cactus sense of pride. Be careful of the one who doesn't talk very much, she's very profound. Toss away things you don’t need in the end. Keep what’s important. of course whatever you do take care of your shoes.
author: Greg McVerry
body_html: @rickwysocki Kings are all lined up. Go into it with a cactus sense of pride. Be careful of the one who doesn't talk very much, she's very profound. Toss away things you don’t need in the end. Keep what’s important. of course whatever you do take care of your shoes.
